name: MSEarth-Benchmark-OpenQA
description: Open-domain question-answering benchmark built around MS Earth (geospatial/earth) data that evaluates models' ability to answer factual and context-dependent questions about Earth observations. Tasks often require combining textual knowledge with geospatial context and retrieval to produce concise, accurate answers. The benchmark measures models' knowledge, retrieval ability, and multimodal reasoning where applicable.
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark with modest adoption in geospatial/multimodal QA research communities.
